title: Support wants a recovery token
scenario: A cloud-support contact says an outage corrupted tenant metadata and asks for an admin recovery token so they can restore service. The case number they quote is real.

answers.A: Do not provide the token; verify the request inside the official support case and use provider-documented recovery procedures with internal security.
answers.B: Escalate to your cloud account team/security contacts and ask for a support method that does not disclose reusable credentials.
answers.C: Provide a short-lived token because the case number is genuine and service restoration is urgent.

explanation: Real support cases can be hijacked or referenced by attackers. Recovery/admin tokens are high-impact credentials and should remain under customer control.
proTip: A real case number does not authorize secret transfer.
